Subject: RFP: Audit logs, retention & exportability — Helix Financial Services

Hi Priya,

Thanks for engaging with Helix on our platform security RFP. Attached is Section 4 of our RFP which focuses on audit logs, retention windows, chain-of-custody and export mechanics. We need concrete, table-driven answers for the following (excerpted):

1) Types of audit events captured (auth, admin actions, model invocations, config changes, routing/fallback events) and an example schema for each.
2) Retention tiers (default, extended, legal hold) and explicit maximum retention windows per tier.
3) Export formats supported (JSON/NDJSON/CSV/Parquet), plus a sample manifest of a 30-day extract.
4) Export SLA and throughput (how quickly can we get a 1TB export; streaming vs snapshot options).
5) Evidence of integrity/tamper-evidence (signed manifests, hash chaining, HSM-stamped fingerprints).
6) Chain-of-custody process for forensic requests (who signs, how timestamps are recorded, delivery artifacts).
7) Locations of stored logs (regions, encrypted-at-rest details, key management).
8) Support for incremental or filtered extracts (by user, timeframe, route, model-version).
9) Price/credits estimate for ad-hoc forensic export and any minimums.

Can you please provide a detailed response (table preferred) and indicate any documentation or artifacts you can share — e.g., sample manifests, schema docs, or runbooks. Helix requires the first pass by Monday 21 Sep EOD PT.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Security Programs
Helix Financial Services
(Attachment: HFS_RFP_Section4_audit.pdf)

From: marissa@redwood.dev

Priya / Laura —

Below are the technical answers we can commit to for an RFP response. I've kept them terse for the table but can expand into the artifacts Priya will attach. Also attaching a sample manifest and an example export schema.

1) Event types / example schemas:
- auth:event: {timestamp, principal_id, method, outcome, ip, request_id}
- admin:config_change: {timestamp, actor, change_type, object_id, before, after, request_id}
- inference:request: {timestamp, model_id, model_version, route, prompt_id, request_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out}
- routing:fallback: {timestamp, route, original_model, fallback_model, reason, request_id}
- system:upgrade: {timestamp, node_id, image, initiated_by, request_id}

Schemas available as NDJSON + JSON Schema; sample attached (redwood_export_sample_manifest.json).

2) Retention tiers:
- Default (operational): 90 days (hot), auto-tier to cold for 365 days total.
- Extended: up to 3 years (cold storage) — available with contract addendum.
- Legal Hold: indefinite (until explicit release); retained in an immutable archive partition with restricted access and audit logging.

3) Export formats supported:
- NDJSON (recommended), JSON, Parquet, CSV (schema-limited).
- Manifests include per-file SHA256, record counts, compressed size, time-range, and event type fingerprints. Sample manifest attached.

4) Export SLA & throughput:
- Standard extracts (operational requests): up to 500GB delivered within 48 hours via S3 presigned URLs.
- Large extracts (500GB–5TB): staged delivery; baseline 5 working days for first TB, then streaming at customer-agreed throughput.
- Forensic / chain-of-custody requests (legal or incident response): 5 business days to produce sealed snapshot + signed manifest; expedited (48–72 hours) available with premium support and commitment.

5) Tamper-evidence / integrity guarantees:
- All exports include a signed manifest with SHA256 per file and an aggregate Merkle root.
- Manifests are signed using an internal HSM-backed signing key; we provide the signing public certificate for verification.
- Optional notarization: we can include a timestamped PKI signature from a 3rd-party timestamping service when requested for legal hold exports.

6) Chain-of-custody:
- We produce a chain-of-custody packet: signed manifest, delivery audit log (who generated export, who approved, timestamped transfers), and MD5/SHA checksums for each part.
- Delivery options: S3 presigned to customer bucket (recommended), direct SFTP with push, or physical transfer for extremely large datasets (rare).

7) Storage locations & key management:
- Primary regions: US-EAST-1, US-WEST-2. Customer can restrict storage region for Private deployments.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; keys stored in KMIP-compatible KMS. For Private customers we support customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key).

8) Incremental & filtered extracts:
- Supported: by request_id, model_version, timeframe, principal_id, route.
- We provide incremental delta exports with cursor tokens for repeated pulls (NDJSON append-friendly).

9) Pricing estimate for ad-hoc forensic export:
- Standard ad-hoc export: $0.10/GB to prepare + egress costs (if applicable).
- Forensic sealed export (signed + notarized): flat prep fee $5k + $0.08/GB for packaging and support SLA.

Artifacts attached: redwood_export_sample_manifest.json, redwood_evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx.

Karthik — the forensic SLA language is in the second section; Laura please sign-off on 5 business days to produce sealed packet.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole

Emma —

Thanks for the RFP excerpt. Please find our consolidated responses below and attached artifacts: redwood_audit_export_summary.pdf, redwood_export_sample_manifest.json, and redwood_evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx. We organized the answers in a simple table (see summary PDF) but key points are repeated inline here for quick consumption.

- Event coverage: auth, admin, inference, routing/fallback, system events. Full example schemas available in the attached manifest (NDJSON + JSON Schema).
- Retention: Default 90 days hot (365 days total w/ auto-tier to cold). Extended up to 3 years with contract; Legal Hold is indefinite on immutable archive partition.
- Formats: NDJSON (recommended), JSON, Parquet, CSV (schema-limited). Manifests include per-file SHA256 and aggregate Merkle root.
- Export SLA: Operational extracts up to 500GB in 48 hours via S3 presigned links. 1TB baseline ~5 business days; forensic sealed packet delivered in 5 business days (expedite available).
- Integrity: HSM-backed manifest signing; we will provide public cert for verification. Optional 3rd-party timestamp notarization available for legal holds.
- Chain-of-custody: Signed manifest + delivery audit log + checksums. Delivery via S3 presigned URLs (recommended) or secure SFTP.
- Filtering & incremental: Supported by request_id, model_version, route, principal_id; incremental cursor-based pulls supported.
- Pricing: Ad-hoc exports: ~$0.10/GB prep + egress; sealed forensic packet: $5k flat prep + $0.08/GB.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm required retention tier and whether you need notarization for legal hold exports.
2) If Helix wants the expedited forensic SLA, indicate urgency and we will open a premium support ticket.
3) If helpful I can walk your team through the sample manifest and the verification steps — available Tue 22 Sep 9–11am PT.

Feel free to reply with the desired retention class and any additional filters you'd like included in the sample extract.

Best,
